pergunta: By border class m(i) (number of sides/corners of the block within b of the node, as defined in section 4.4), in the four Q1 cells and the 200 split draws of fase1/1.8: does the frequency of inclusion in the test conditional on the block being test (p_{i|te}) match the closed form where the proposition declares it exact and respect the bounds where it gives bounds?

leituras.L_no_a_no: exact (=lo) where m=0 or condition (iii) holds at the node (computed per node); others bounds only. Primary fixed a priori (literal reading of prop:inclusion (iii)).
leituras.T_classe: exact at m=0,1,3; bounds only at m=2 and m>=4 (text of main.tex l.312).
leituras.C_todas: lo treated as an exact value in every class (ignores (iii)).
leituras.U_so_m0: exact only at m=0; m>=1 bounds only.

ambiguidades: The proposition says that the lower bound is ATTAINED IF hypothesis (iii) holds; it does not say that it fails outside it nor does it declare per class what is exact. The four readings (L, T, C, U) are implemented and reported; none was chosen after seeing the number.

m(i) has two definitions in the material: nodal (main.tex l.296: blocks with >= 1 node at < b; used in the proposition) and geometric (sides/corners at < b, as the decision criterion and fismat_k_corrigido.py describe). Both reported; the differences are discretization and thin blocks.
'declared exact' in the decision criterion: only m=0 has lower bound = upper bound (p=1). In the other classes the proposition only states 'attained if (iii)'.

trabalho_anterior.fismat_k_corrigido: geometric class m (8-neighbourhood by distance to face/vertex) only in Bauru Q1, 100+100 seeds; classified as contested in the record index; here: exact nodal m in the 4 cells, condition (iii) per node, 200 seeds of 1.8, SE by bootstrap over split draws
trabalho_anterior.fismat_inclusao_decomp: decomposition of m=1/m=2/m=3 for Bauru Q1 from the fismat_k_corrigido JSON; not recomputed
trabalho_anterior.fismat_razao_cov: ratio identity and decomposition of retention by lateral class k (1.6); does not cover p per class m
trabalho_anterior.p_inclusao_por_no_1_6: lateral-only profile by class k with errata; not used as comparator
